assessments.reasoning: The 45,264-byte artifact comes from SPDX data commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 and identifies the 3.29.0 creator. Its full digest and six controlled ranges verified. The structured fields establish membership and status. The comment resolves the possible overreading of the example header by expressly leaving each feature open.

challenge.method: Tested whether the header's list placeholders require any feature to be present. Compared the filename and spdxId with the comment, then applied the generic meaning to four hypothetical notices.
challenge.results: A 1.2-only grant with a Back-Cover Text and zero Invariant Sections fits the generic identifier. So does a 1.2-only grant with all three features absent. The generic choice communicates the same edition scope in both cases and preserves neither case's feature details by itself. An unavailable notice supplies no basis to infer a 1.2-only grant. An or-later notice authorizes a broader choice, which the generic edition-only identifier would misstate.

limitations: The comment reverses suffix order in its optional-feature references, including GFDL-1.2-only-no-invariants. The generic identifier itself agrees across the filename, ListedLicense spdxId and comment.
The generic identifier leaves each feature unspecified. SPDX metadata cannot establish an unknown work's edition choice or replace its authorized notice.
reasoning: In SPDX License List 3.29.0, GFDL-1.2-only.json contains a ListedLicense with spdxId http://spdx.org/licenses/GFDL-1.2-only, name GNU Free Documentation License v1.2 only, and deprecation flag false. The example header selects 1.2 alone and has placeholders for all three feature lists. The comment expressly permits use of the generic identifier without making any assertion about Invariant Sections, Front-Cover Texts or Back-Cover Texts.
